title: The Latest in Tyres
accessBasis: Digitized period magazine technical survey reviewed in full
limitations: Period commercial/technical survey; it identifies products and constructions but does not supply racing pressure, temperature, stiffness or F&M measurements.

title: Continental Notes — June 1968
accessBasis: Digitized period magazine page reviewed in full
limitations: Qualitative period observation; no pressure, temperature, force/moment or tire-rate table.

title: Continental Notes — August 1959
accessBasis: Digitized period magazine page reviewed in full
reviewLocation: Reims Grand Prix and Formula 2 tire observations
limitations: Race-report observation under unusually hot conditions; absence of tire changes is durability evidence, not a quantified wear curve or exact stint-life proof for every car.

title: Dunlop history
limitations: Modern supplier retrospective. The page says RS5; do not silently substitute R5 or infer period pressure/thermal coefficients.

title: Dunlop Vintage Racing Tire Pressure Guide
reviewLocation: Vintage/R5, L-section, M-section, Post Historic and Group C pressure tables and axle-balance notes
limitations: Modern reproduction-racing guidance, not an original-period racing-pressure source. It supports architecture and present-day setup validation only.

title: 1996 IMSA GTS Technical Regulations
accessBasis: Official FIA Historic Database regulation scan reviewed
limitations: Primary regulation/fitment evidence; not a source for operating pressure, temperature, compound performance, stiffness or wear.

title: Mitsubishi Motors WRC 1993
accessBasis: Official manufacturer motorsport history page reviewed
limitations: Manufacturer retrospective for regulation context only; no tire operating data.

title: Appendix K to the International Sporting Code — 2025
accessBasis: Official FIA regulation PDF reviewed for historic category and tire-rule structure
reviewLocation: Historic period/category definitions and current historic tire provisions
limitations: Authoritative for current historic-competition rules and ontology, not automatically evidence of original-period pressures, compounds or race practice.

title: Porsche 956/962 — 40 years of Group C
limitations: Vehicle/championship chronology only; no tire parameter evidence.

title: Dunlop Motor Sport History — 1982
limitations: Later supplier retrospective useful for acquisition routing; it does not provide compound, pressure, thermal, stiffness or wear measurements.

title: Dunlop Vintage Racing Tire Dimensions and Applications
limitations: Current reproduction-tire catalogue; dimensions and applications must not be represented as original-period fitment without corroboration.
